requestOutcomes.outcome: Viewer loads publicly. BIC advertises digital parcel coverage only for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu. Current bundle uses a public Supabase project.

requestOutcomes.outcome: 200 JSON response returned. available_provinces was [Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu]; search examples were generic parcel references. No Lisala/Mongala layer or geometry configuration was returned.

requestOutcomes.outcome: No usable public paths/schema were returned for parcel geometry discovery. No parcel table or bounded ID+geometry response was retained.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Procedure requires a formal request and parcel/reference information; pages expose no anonymous parcel geometry API. No form was submitted.

localRegistryCustodian.evidence: Ministry directory explicitly lists Lisala as a circonscription foncière under Mongala.

scopeLimits: Research covered public first-party web pages, the BIC viewer's current public bundle/configuration, and anonymous REST metadata/config requests only.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe owner/title/address/tax query was used.
No parcel polygon was retained because no safe native identity plus public geometry response was available.
The official custodian listing is not equivalent to citywide digital parcel coverage.
safeFieldAllowlist: source field names in metadata only
runtimeReadinessReason: Independent serial adapter qualification remains outstanding; this packet records source discovery only and does not claim source integration/admission.
uncertainty: BIC's advertised province coverage may change independently of the Ministry's local registry records.
A public map extent miss or absent API is not evidence of citywide absence.
The exact WUP point was preserved as [longitude, latitude] per queue convention and was not shifted to seek a parcel hit.
